decisions.rationale: Paystub shows commission ($1,680.77 of $5,307.69 gross), so variable income applies and AR-02 requires two NOAs; only one NOA (2025) is on file. Per AR-01 that one NOA ($138,319.94 vs stated $138,000) shows no shortfall, but one year only means needs_review.

Statement 4-Apr to 2-Jun-2026 spans only 59 days, below the 90 days required (AR-05). Balance $102,220.34 covers required $66,500 + 1.5% x 665,000 (9,975) = $76,475 and no deposit exceeds $2,500, but seasoning fails.
Employment letter dated May 26, 2026 (11 days old) was sent from a personal mail account with no letterhead, so AR-16 gives not_satisfied.
